mentions.name: Innovative guided munition for Ukraine
mentions.description: This project develops an innovative guided munition for Ukraine. First prototypes have been manufactured, with arrangements in place to begin flight testing at a testing range soon.
mentions.problem: Supporting Ukraine's defense effort with guided munitions.
